class.name: FluidSynth
class.brief_description: Singleton synthesizer that renders MIDI through FluidSynth.
class.description: FluidSynth is a Node singleton registered as Engine singleton "FluidSynth" ([code]Engine.get_singleton("FluidSynth")[/code]). It owns [code]fluid_settings_t[/code], [code]fluid_synth_t[/code] and a list of [code]fluid_player_t[/code] instances, synthesizes stereo frames via [code]fluid_synth_write_float[/code], and is pumped each [code]NOTIFICATION_INTERNAL_PROCESS[/code]. SoundFonts and MIDI are held as [SoundFontFileReader] and [MidiFileReader] resources and fed to the synth through a custom [code]fluid_sfloader_t[/code] that decodes pseudo-paths of the form [code]&%p[/code] and through [code]fluid_player_add_mem[/code] respectively. The node is created at [code]MODULE_INITIALIZATION_LEVEL_SCENE[/code] and deferred-adds itself to the scene root.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Deferred initializer that adds the singleton to the scene tree. Called automatically via [code]call_deferred("initialize")[/code] in the constructor.

method.name: process
method.description: Reaps players whose status is [code]FLUID_PLAYER_DONE[/code]. Invoked from [code]_notification(NOTIFICATION_INTERNAL_PROCESS)[/code].

method.name: program_select
method.description: Selects a program on [param chan] via [code]fluid_synth_program_select(synth, chan, sfont_id, bank_num, preset_num)[/code].

method.name: pitch_bend
method.description: Sets pitch bend [param val] in [0, 16383] (8192 is center) via [code]fluid_synth_pitch_bend[/code].

method.name: play_midi
method.description: Creates a new [code]fluid_player_t[/code], copies [param midi_file] bytes (or the [member midi_file] property when null) via [code]fluid_player_add_mem[/code], and appends the player to the internal list. Each call adds a new player; finished players are freed in [method process].

method.name: set_soundfont
method.description: Loads the [SoundFontFileReader] at [param soundfont] via [code]ResourceLoader[/code] and calls [code]fluid_synth_sfload[/code] with a pseudo-path encoding the resource address.

method.name: get_soundfont
method.description: Returns the cached [SoundFontFileReader] reference (may be null if no soundfont has been set).

method.name: set_midi_file
method.description: Sets the default MIDI file used when [method play_midi] is called with null.

members.member: SoundFont resource used for synthesis. The setter takes a [String] path and loads the [SoundFontFileReader]; the getter returns the cached resource.
